training.clock: original panel rows; label at t ends at t+label_horizon; strict endpoint gaps
training.checkpoint_selection: minimum trailing-validation loss within each history window; fresh model/optimizer each fold
limitations: Input features, label timing, universe and preprocessing must be causal and accurately declared.
Forecasts use signal availability only; future label eligibility is exclusively an offline training/evaluation filter.
Hyperparameters and input selection are fixed by the caller; retrospective tuning needs an outer holdout.
Predictions and coverage are engineering outputs, not portfolio returns or deployable alpha.
Earlier OOS observations may become later training history; this is sequential refitting, not one permanent holdout.

accounting.description: Marked actual holdings; directional price/volume gates; sells then cash-funded pro-rata buys. One-way fees on fills; no queue/settlement/impact model.

execution.fill_assumption: permitted orders fill at close mark; same-row net sale proceeds fund buys
execution.missing_band_policy: absent columns impose no limit proxy; invalid supplied cells block direction
execution.policy: observed positive close and volume; directional supplied close-price bands

accounting.notional_cap: none; Python API accepts max_trade_values in account currency units

constrained_backtest.disclaimer: Synthetic research output only; not investment advice or evidence of live performance.

cost_aware_backtest.workflow: closed-loop cost-aware planning from actual marked holdings; no model retraining

execution.policy: observed positive close and volume; directional supplied close-price bands
execution.missing_band_policy: absent columns impose no limit proxy; invalid supplied cells block direction
execution.fill_assumption: permitted orders fill at close mark; same-row net sale proceeds fund buys
execution.forecast_coverage: buys require a valid signal-date prediction; sells retain market permissions

limitations: One-period forecasts must be expected simple returns; calibration and alpha remain unvalidated.
Covariance uses strictly prior return rows; missing/zero-filled market histories still need source validation.
Position value cap and cash floor use pre-trade NAV units; drifted holdings may remain but cannot be increased beyond that value.
Same-row sale proceeds and mark-price fills; no settlement, impact, queue or lot-size model.
Failed/infeasible solves hold actual positions and record the reason; no silent forced liquidation.
